[[Railroad]] |Season = {{Season|Any}} |Edibility = -300 |Sell Price = {{Price|750}} |dsvprice = 750 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] item that can be found by digging up [[Stardew:Artifact Spot|Artifact Spots]] in the following locations: * [[Adventurer's Summit]]: 33% chance * [[Stardew:Backwoods|Backwoods]]: 4% chance * [[Blue Moon Vineyard]]: 2% chance * [[Cindersap Forest]]: 6% chance * [[Stardew:The Farm|The Farm]]: 3% chance * [[Stardew:The Mines|The Mines]]: 10% chance * [[The Mountain]]: 10% chance * [[Railroad]]: 7% chance It can also be purchased from the Red Junimo in the [[Junimo Woods]] or [[Joja Emporium]], when players take the Joja Route, for {{Price|10000}}. A single {{PAGENAME}} is required to be donated to the [[Stardew:Museum|Museum]] to complete the collection. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |like=Clint, Dwarf, Olivia, Penny }} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== When '''SVE Community Bundles''' is selected in the [[Configuration Options]], {{PAGENAME}} can be used to fulfill the {{Bundle|research|32|y}}. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|yellow}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} results in a yellow color. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
